purpose: Implement the first cross-system platform chassis slice: canonical OS/CPU environment identity and deterministic N0TE application data/config/state/cache/log root resolution for macOS, Windows and Linux without leaking platform/path mechanics into Artist/Song identity.

lineage.outcome: The same N0TE profile/Artist/Song meaning can live in normal OS-conventional application locations across macOS, Windows and Linux without developer paths or host-branded state becoming identity.
lineage.capability: Platform environment identity and application-root resolution

completion_proof: Darwin/macOS, Windows aliases and Linux normalize to canonical platform families; unknown families remain explicit UNSUPPORTED
arm64/aarch64, x86_64/amd64/x64, x86-32, armv7 and riscv64 aliases normalize without turning unknown architectures into supported claims
target tier distinguishes CORE_TARGET, EXTENDED_TARGET, UNVERIFIED and UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM as policy targets rather than acceptance evidence
macOS resolves Application Support, Caches and Logs roots under the supplied home
Windows honors explicit APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA and has deterministic user-home fallbacks
Linux honors XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME and standard home fallbacks
relative homes/overrides and unsupported platform families fail visibly instead of guessing
profile IDs remain opaque path components and root relocation does not regenerate or reinterpret identity
resolution performs zero filesystem writes and never consults cwd
no resolved root uses legacy .n0te-ableton-ai or a DAW-branded product directory
next_selection_rule: After PLATFORM-00A evidence, reconcile and globally compare the remaining PLATFORM-00 shared prerequisites (process/security/package/architecture-worker boundary) against dependency-ready DAW-00 and preserved CORE-02 Success Memory. Do not stay on path code by adjacency.
